# Christopher Schmidt

> Christopher Schmidt is an enterprise technology leader who builds and modernizes production platforms, leads engineering organizations, scales enterprise adoption, and created the Data and AI Readiness Framework (DARF).

## Leadership

- [Leadership work](https://christophermschmidt.com/work): Selected work across enterprise adoption, supplier-risk operations, and production SaaS modernization.
- [Approach](https://christophermschmidt.com/approach): Use-case-led delivery with accountable ownership and reusable foundations.
- [About](https://christophermschmidt.com/about): Executive biography and operating perspective.

## Framework

- [DARF overview](https://christophermschmidt.com/darf): Two pillars, eight layers, and 53 capabilities that distinguish trusted answers from governed action.
- [DARF capability library](https://christophermschmidt.com/darf/capabilities): Canonical capability definitions, failure modes, maturity anchors, evidence requirements, prerequisites, and sources.
- [Fictional decision example](https://christophermschmidt.com/darf/example): A bounded teaching example. It is not a readiness score, certification, or deployment authorization.

## Writing and speaking

- [Writing and speaking](https://christophermschmidt.com/writing): Curated entry point to published essays and selected public talks.
- [Article archive](https://christophermschmidt.com/articles): Stable local article routes.
- [Speaking archive](https://christophermschmidt.com/speaking): Published conference and user-group appearances.

The published DARF has two pillars. The assessment kit's Semantic, AI, and Context profiles are reporting views, not additional pillars. Enterprise Adoption & Transformation Readiness is research in development and is not a published pillar.
